title: Repair installs with the exact client/runtime pair, even from an older release.
changes: Converge a local remcp install to the runtime paired with the running client when the saved first-party pin is stale; custom runtime packages remain untouched.
Keep the Windows bootstrap compatible with npm-generated PowerShell shims across npm formatting changes, refusing only foreign or downloading launchers.
Keep exact client/runtime pairing, service supervision and update locks unchanged.
